events.address: Union Square Plaza, Broadway between E 17th & E 18th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile scalp-care pop-up bringing Dr. Groot's Korean hair and scalp-care products, fragrances and scalp-first product education to Union Square.
events.what_is_free: Free public access to the interactive scalp lab and product exploration; current public listings do not establish a guaranteed take-home giveaway.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources agree on the Union Square Plaza location and date-specific hours. No advance RSVP requirement is published in those listings. Do not imply guaranteed samples or gifts because the current event copy only establishes product exploration/interactive experiences.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16, 11 AM–7 PM; Thursday, September 17, 11 AM–5 PM. Open to the public at Union Square Plaza.

events.brand: Krave Beauty x Go Greek Yogurt
events.address: Go Greek Yogurt, 683 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A one-day Krave Beauty takeover with Go Greek Yogurt celebrating Mochi Berrier Moisture Cream, featuring a Berrier Bounce smoothie, a typewriter poet, DJ and the Krave Beauty team.
events.what_is_free: The event itself is free to attend. A full-size Mochi Berrier Moisture Cream is free with purchase of the Berrier Bounce smoothie while supplies last; personalized poems are offered while the poet is on site. The first 30 Reset Room members who use the stated code word are advertised to receive flowers.
events.caveats: Current event listing advertises free RSVP but the direct registration destination was not independently recovered in this pass, so the main source is retained rather than inventing a direct RSVP URL. The full-size moisturizer requires purchase of the collaboration smoothie and is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16, 4–5 PM at 683 Broadway. Registration is advertised as free; check the main source for the current RSVP action.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture education and sampling, and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day receive a complimentary mini Apothékary tincture; tincture sampling and kakigori are advertised, with shaved ice and gifts subject to availability. A separate gift with purchase and 20% product discount are also offered.
events.caveats: The current organizer Eventbrite confirms the address, three-day schedule and first-50 mini tincture offer. Complimentary items are limited/while supplies last. Registration is via the organizer's Eventbrite listing.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 18, 1–9 PM; Saturday and Sunday, September 19–20, 9 AM–9 PM. Use the organizer Eventbrite listing for registration.

events.event_name: Yepoda x Sephora: The Dewy Day Tour — NYC
events.address: Sep 19: Sephora Meatpacking, 21-27 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014; Sep 20: Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty tour with Sephora, offering product try-ons, free gifts while supplies last, prize opportunities and purchase-based gifts.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the advertised general freebies; free gifts are while supplies last. Separate gifts with purchase require qualifying Sephora spend.
events.caveats: Yepoda's organizer Eventbrite directly verifies the September 19 Meatpacking occurrence and states no purchase is necessary to attend and receive freebies. Current tour coverage also lists a September 20 Union Square stop from 12–6 PM; that second occurrence should be treated as the same underlying tour event, not a duplicate event. Free gifts remain subject to availability; purchase-based GWPs are separate.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19, 12–6 PM at Sephora Meatpacking; Sunday, September 20, 12–6 PM at Sephora Union Square. Free registration is available for the Meatpacking stop through Yepoda's organizer Eventbrite listing.
